GLHEX.import.title: Hexcrawl Import / Export
GLHEX.import.hint: Paste a hexcrawl map in the glhex-map JSON format, or load a .json file. Check it first — anything the importer had to guess is listed before a scene is touched.
GLHEX.import.replaceConfirm: Replace the whole hexcrawl map on "{name}"? Terrain, regions, landmarks and fog are overwritten. Tokens and the scene itself are untouched.
GLHEX.import.empty: Paste or load a JSON document first.
GLHEX.import.gridMismatch: The document was written for a different hex layout than this scene's grid — hexes will land in different places.
